$comment: Tables where RLS is enabled with ZERO policies on purpose — a deny-all lockdown. They are only reachable through server-side code (service role / SECURITY DEFINER functions), never from the browser. `npm run check:rls` treats these as OK; every other policy-less table fails the build.

tables.mcp_idempotency: Server-only idempotency keys for MCP calls.
tables.share_promos: Server-only share promo cache; rendered through server functions.
